printf '
alias ll="ls -lah"
alias gs="git status"
' >> ~/.bashrc

sudo tee /etc/hosts <<'EOF'
127.0.0.1 localhost
10.0.4.12 acme-db.internal
10.0.4.19 acme-cache.internal
EOF
crontab -l | { cat; echo "0 3 * * * /usr/local/bin/acme-backup.sh >> /var/log/acme-backup.log 2>&1"; } | crontab -

cat > ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.acme.sync.plist <<'EOF'
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<plist version="1.0"><dict>
<key>Label</key><string>com.acme.sync</string>
<key>ProgramArguments</key><array><string>/usr/local/bin/acme-sync</string></array>
<key>StartInterval</key><integer>300</integer>
</dict></plist>
EOF
launchctl load -w ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.acme.sync.plist
sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl enable --now acme-api.service
echo "deploy ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL" | sudo tee /etc/sudoers.d/deploy && sudo visudo -c

git config --global core.hooksPath ~/.githooks
git config --global credential.helper osxkeychain

ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -N "" -f ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_acme -C "nikhil@laptop"
chmod 700 ~/.ssh && chmod 600 ~/.ssh/config ~/.ssh/known_hosts
sudo sed -i.bak 's/^#\?PermitRootLogin.*/PermitRootLogin no/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && sudo systemctl restart sshd

sudo pfctl -f /etc/pf.conf -e && sudo pfctl -s rules

sudo scutil --set HostName acme-devbox && sudo scutil --set LocalHostName acme-devbox

chsh -s /bin/zsh $(whoami)
sudo spctl --master-disable
sudo /usr/bin/socketfilterfw --setglobalstate off
sudo systemsetup -setremotelogin on && sudo systemsetup -setcomputersleep Never
sudo pmset -a sleep 0 disablesleep 1
echo "UUID=8f2c-11ab /data ext4 defaults,noatime 0 2" | sudo tee -a /etc/fstab && sudo mount -a

sudo tee /etc/security/limits.conf <<'EOF'
* soft nofile 65535
* hard nofile 65535
EOF
echo 'net.ipv4.ip_forward=1' | sudo tee /etc/sysctl.d/99-acme-network.conf && sudo sysctl --system
sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y nginx redis-tools
sudo dnf install -y htop jq ripgrep
sudo pacman -S --noconfirm --needed base-devel openssl
brew services start postgresql@16 && brew services list
sudo npm install -g pnpm@9 typescript ts-node
sudo pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
sudo gem install bundler -v 2.5.9
sudo ln -sfn /usr/local/opt/python@3.12/bin/python3.12 /usr/local/bin/python3
sudo update-alternatives --set java /usr/lib/jvm/temurin-21-jdk-amd64/bin/java
sudo chown -R $(whoami):staff /usr/local/lib/node_modules /usr/local/bin
echo 'export NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192' | sudo tee -a /etc/environment
defaults write com.apple.finder AppleShowAllFiles -bool true && killall Finder

[Install]

EOF

sudo git config --system http.sslVerify true && sudo git config --system core.autocrlf input

printf 'eval "$(starship init zsh)"\n' >> ~/.zshrc && exec zsh -l

/var/log/acme/*.log {
  daily
  rotate 14
  compress

}
EOF

sudo iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 8080 -j ACCEPT && sudo iptables-save | sudo tee /etc/iptables/rules.v4
sudo firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=8080/tcp && sudo firewall-cmd --reload
sudo cp ./deploy/nginx.conf /etc/nginx/nginx.conf && sudo nginx -t && sudo nginx -s reload
sudo install -m 0755 ./scripts/deploy.sh /usr/local/bin/acme-deploy

sudo systemctl disable --now firewalld
sudo aa-complain /usr/sbin/nginx && sudo aa-status --complaining

echo '/usr/local/bin/fish' | sudo tee -a /etc/shells && sudo chsh -s /usr/local/bin/fish deploy

  User deploy
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_acme

EOF

EOF

[Service]

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF

sudo nvram boot-args="kext-dev-mode=1" && sudo reboot

10.20.0.5 gitlab.acme.internal
10.20.0.9 registry.acme.internal
EOF

br_netfilter
overlay
EOF

echo 'deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/nodesource.gpg] https://deb.nodesource.com/node_20.x nodistro main' | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/nodesource.list
sudo chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/acme-deploy /usr/local/bin/acme-agent
sudo systemctl disable --now apparmor && sudo systemctl status apparmor --no-pager
echo 'export PATH="/opt/acme/bin:$PATH"' | sudo tee /etc/profile.d/acme-path.sh && source /etc/profile.d/acme-path.sh

sudo tee /etc/dnsmasq.d/acme.conf <<'EOF'
address=/acme.local/127.0.0.1

sudo tee -a ~/.ssh/config <<'EOF'

  HostName bastion.acme.internal
  User deploy
  ForwardAgent no
EOF
sudo update-rc.d acme-agent defaults && sudo service acme-agent start

sudo systemctl enable --now docker && sudo usermod -aG docker $USER && newgrp docker

EOF

%deploy ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: ACME

sudo tee /etc/sysconfig/acme <<'EOF'

ACME_PORT=8080
EOF
sudo launchctl config user path /usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin

sudo apt-get remove -y --purge telnet rsh-client
sudo sysctl -w kernel.unprivileged_bpf_disabled=0 && echo 'kernel.unprivileged_bpf_disabled=0' | sudo tee /etc/sysctl.d/99-bpf.conf

sudo tee /Library/Preferences/com.acme.agent.plist <<'EOF'
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<plist version="1.0"><dict><key>ServerURL</key><string>https://sync.acme.internal</string></dict></plist>
EOF
sudo chflags nohidden /usr/local/bin && sudo chflags hidden /opt/acme/.secret

enabled = true
maxretry = 5
bantime = 3600

vm.swappiness=10
EOF
sudo sysctl -p /etc/sysctl.d/99-swappiness.conf
sudo systemctl disable --now snapd.service snapd.socket snapd.seeded.service

sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/acme-agent.service <<'EOF' > /dev/null && sudo systemctl enable acme-agent.service
[Unit]
Description=Acme Agent
[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/acme-agent --daemon
Restart=on-failure
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
sudo mkdir -p /etc/acme && sudo cp -R ./ops/etc/. /etc/acme/ && sudo chmod -R go-w /etc/acme

sudo tee /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/20-acme.conf <<'EOF'
ClientAliveInterval 300
MaxAuthTries 3
AllowGroups ssh-users
EOF
sudo sshd -t && sudo systemctl reload sshd
sudo systemctl enable --now chronyd && sudo chronyc sources

sudo tee /etc/sudo.conf <<'EOF'
Plugin sudoers_policy sudoers.so

sudo visudo -c
sudo defaults write /Library/Preferences/com.apple.SoftwareUpdate AutomaticCheckEnabled -bool true
sudo ln -sfn /opt/acme/current /opt/acme/active && sudo chown -R deploy:deploy /opt/acme

sudo tee /etc/modsecurity/modsecurity.conf <<'EOF'
SecRuleEngine On
SecRequestBodyLimit 13107200
EOF
sudo systemctl enable --now systemd-timesyncd && timedatectl set-ntp true

sudo tee /etc/profile.d/acme-umask.sh <<'EOF'

EOF
source /etc/profile.d/acme-umask.sh

sudo tee /etc/security/access.conf <<'EOF'
+:root:LOCAL
-:ALL:ALL
EOF
sudo systemctl daemon-reexec && sudo systemctl daemon-reload

sudo tee /etc/systemd/coredump.conf <<'EOF'
[Coredump]
Storage=none
EOF
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
echo "Set disable-completion On" >> ~/.inputrc

input.content:
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH"
export EDITOR=nvim
export LANG=en_US.UTF-8
alias gs='git status -sb'
alias ll='ls -lah'

[user]
	name = Mira Chen
	email = mira@acme.io
[core]
	hooksPath = ~/.githooks
	excludesfile = ~/.gitignore_global
[pull]
	rebase = true

Host acme-bastion
  HostName bastion.acme.internal
  User deploy
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_acme
  IdentitiesOnly yes
  ForwardAgent no

[Unit]
Description=Acme API
After=network-online.target

[Service]
User=acme
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/acme-api --port 8080
Restart=always

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

Cmnd_Alias ACME = /usr/bin/systemctl restart acme-api, /usr/bin/systemctl status acme-api
%deploy ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: ACME
Defaults:%deploy !requiretty

*    soft    nofile    65535
*    hard    nofile    65535
root soft    nproc     unlimited
root hard    nproc     unlimited

PermitRootLogin no
PasswordAuthentication no
MaxAuthTries 3
ClientAliveInterval 300
AllowGroups ssh-users

/var/log/acme/*.log {
  daily
  rotate 14
  compress
  missingok
  notifempty
  copytruncate
}

[Unit]
Description=Acme nightly sync

[Timer]
OnCalendar=*-*-* 02:00:00
Persistent=true

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

set -gx EDITOR nvim
set -gx PATH $HOME/.local/bin $PATH
fish_add_path /opt/homebrew/bin
